verdict.rationale: mParticle's documentation has a dedicated 'Feeds' guide, the product's own named inbound-feed capability, but the pack shows only its title, with no description of which third-party cloud apps or partner feeds can send data in. Warehouse Sync ingests from the customer's own warehouse, not from third-party apps, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. Missing for 10: description of the Feeds mechanism, a list of supported third-party inbound sources, setup and data-mapping documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can pull customer data in from third-party cloud apps and feeds — not just my own instrumented apps
